content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:12 UTC] Write a Python script that periodically scans system configuration files for modifications.
[Wed 2026-05-20 12:13 UTC] Create a new systemd unit file named 'sec-monitor.service' in /etc/systemd/system/.

arguments.content:
[Unit]
Description=System Configuration File Security Monitor
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /root/.openclaw/workspace/config_scanner.py
WorkingDirectory=/root/.openclaw/workspace
Restart=always
RestartSec=30
User=root
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
